auth.why: To save a payment method for the one-time flat $49 pack fee, charged off-session only after you confirm.

description: The address-change circus, handled in one pack. Builds a state-specific moving checklist (USPS mail forwarding, DMV deadline, voter registration, banks, employer, insurance, IRS, utilities, subscriptions), printable as PDF, for a flat $49 per move. The agent is the UI — everything happens in chat. We never file an address change on your behalf; you complete each step through the official links.

proactive_triggers.description: Lease, mover confirmation, or USPS change-of-address email in Gmail
proactive_triggers.nudge: Looks like you moved from {from_address} to {to_address}. I can handle the whole address-change circus — USPS, banks, voter registration — in one $49 pack. Want it? One tap.

tools.description: Start a move pack: name, email, old/new address, move date, new state. Builds the checklist and fans the move out to the suite.
tools.name: create_move

tools.description: Get move details, checklist progress, and items
tools.name: get_move

tools.description: Fetch the address-change pack (markdown + PDF link). Unlocks after the $49 fee is paid.
tools.name: get_pack

tools.description: Set up billing for the $49 pack fee: creates the Stripe customer and card SetupIntent. Returns the client_secret for card collection. No charge happens here.
tools.name: setup_billing

tools.description: Charge the flat $49.00 pack fee off-session against the saved card, then deliver the pack. Idempotent — never double-charges.
tools.name: pay

tools.description: Receive a fanned-out life event from the shared bus. A 'move' creates a draft move and the proactive nudge.
tools.name: receive_life_event
